sources.S1: NASA NSSDC Earth Fact Sheet (eccentricity 0.0167): https://nssdc.gsfc.nasa.gov/planetary/factsheet/earthfact.html . Not opened (egress); same source and grade as part 1 S1.
sources.S2: factory/topics/noether-applied/verlet_vs_rk4.c (A, derived) + data/trace.c + recompute.py: Earth-shaped orbit e = 0.0167, G*M = 1, 100 steps per lap, velocity Verlet vs classical RK4. gcc -O2; reproducible.
sources.S3: Wisdom and Holman, Symplectic maps for the N-body problem, Astron. J. 102, 1528-1538 (1991), doi 10.1086/115978 (A, bibliographic); Hairer, Lubich, Wanner, Geometric numerical integration illustrated by the Stormer-Verlet method, Acta Numerica 2003 (B, backward error analysis); Laskar and Gastineau, Nature 459, 817-819 (2009) (A). No number from these is on screen.
sources.S4: Stepsize errors in the N-body problem (arXiv 2111.08835) and Brown/perihelion note arXiv math-ph/0608012 (B, snippets): large steps and adaptive steps break the symplectic guarantee. Backs the honest line only.
sources.S5: Greydanus, Dzamba, Yosinski, Hamiltonian Neural Networks, NeurIPS 2019, arXiv 1906.01563: Table 1 ideal mass-spring energy error 170 +/- 20 (baseline) vs 0.38 +/- 0.1 (HNN), units 1e-3; 3 layers, 200 hidden units, tanh, 2,000 gradient steps (setup confirmed in a second search extraction this session). Not opened (egress).
sources.S6: Du, Hu, Lee, Algorithmic regularization in learning deep homogeneous models: layers are automatically balanced, NeurIPS 2018, arXiv 1806.00900 (A, three extractions).
sources.S7: Kunin, Sagastuy-Brena, Ganguli, Yamins, Tanaka, Neural mechanics, ICLR 2021, arXiv 2012.04728: finite learning rates and weight decay break the conservation law (A). Backs the honest line and the 0.00095 note.
sources.S8: factory/topics/noether-symmetry/recompute.py v2, seed 20261010: 100 runs x 100 recorded steps of a 2-layer ReLU net, 16 hidden units; median weights travel 0.2378, median conserved-sum movement 0.000952 (data/recompute_out.json C). Reused unchanged; MODEL.
sources.S9: Kelvin 1869 (circulation theorem); Salmon, Annu. Rev. Fluid Mech. 20, 225-256 (1988) and Salmon 2013 (relabelling gives the vorticity laws by Noether, B); UK Met Office GungHo programme (a dynamical core designed to improve conservation properties, B). data/kelvin_loop.csv: three point vortices stir a loop of 2,000 parcels (our MODEL). No number from the literature is on screen.
sources.S10: Jumper et al., Highly accurate protein structure prediction with AlphaFold, Nature 596, 583-589 (2021), doi 10.1038/s41586-021-03819-2, Fig. 1d caption: CASP14 target T1044 (PDB 6VR4), a 2,180-residue single chain (A, PMC8371605 caption read in two extractions); the structure module is invariant to rotation and translation of the input frame (B, secondary reads; AlphaFold 3 dropped the explicit guarantee, B). recompute.py D: our stand-in chain and equivariant layer (MODEL).
